answer: Pewter ingots stack by the pewterer's moulds, dull grey and soft. crystal melts the metal in the ladle and skims the dross. Proof of pewterer via pewter plate tally — a plate the pewterer casts only after 647 plates cast true without one warping at the rim, each cast by the pewterer himself. dune pours the mould full and lets it set. beacon turns the plate on the lathe and burnishes the rim. Six hundred and forty-seven plates must cast true without one warping at the rim, and the next still warps where the metal ran hot.
